subject: Re: Kickoff: romanized input for South Asian languages
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Yara Jokic leads at 40%, Wanjiru Horvat 35% on the FST/Nisaba integration, Rosa Mensah 30% on the evaluation harness and text-resource staging.

Platform dependency worth calling out: the released text resources and our eval corpora need to move onto Corpus v2, and the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07 — so we have until early August to finish registrations, which comfortably covers the whole window. Rosa will do the migration alongside the harness work in June rather than as a scramble later.

Compute: negligible — FSTs are CPU-bound and the neural checkpoints are inference-only for our comparison. No reservations.

One flag: Nisaba version pinning matters; Wanjiru hit a grammar incompatibility on the newest release and is pinning to the version the models shipped against.

Daniela
